milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the yellow bed (located at spawn-relative [9, 1, 10] inside the oak house) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the yellow bed'. max_distance=16 allows detection from the structure entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the bed rather than facing away.
